name: yourproject-sample-run
notes: The child's pipeline document: the smallest real DAG over its own registered kinds (data -> transform), template for every run the child declares. Once the child is installed (pip install -e . from the child root) it runs through the ONE universal command line: python -m dskit.pipeline run configs/run-sample.json --asof 2026-01-01 --adapter yourproject — the --adapter flag imports the package, and import = registration, which is what makes the 'yourproject-*' kind names below resolve. tests/test_nodes.py runs this same document in-process through the same entry the CLI uses.

sample.notes: Role 'data' (declared by the class, never by config): the child's source. No 'limit' set = the whole table; a real child's source node points at its store here.

enrich.notes: Role 'transform': every record gains derived = value * factor. 'factor' is required on purpose — the derivation is stated in the document, never defaulted in code.

outputs.notes: Empty = ./pipeline_runs under the invoking cwd. Placement is not identity (hash-excluded); the child's e2e test overrides it with a tmp dir.
